'''Black Sun Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] military group serving [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] that fielded [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], the predecessor to the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]]. The fighter craft of the unit were painted white and marked with Black Sun's logo on the wing panels. Made up of the most ruthless fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], veteran [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that made up the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] were proud to be flying for the most feared crime syndicate of its time. The best aces were occasionally selected&mdash;based on how effective their ruthless tactics were&mdash;to be attached to [[Elite Black Sun]], an exclusive squadron of the organization's top-ranking pilots.
